diagnostic: A temporary pass that only read each contact's 64-byte hot tag (the persist pass's FINAL early-exit) added 0.66 ms to gables warm (1.90 -> 2.56 ms): ~4M early-exit threads each pull a record line, and ~2/3 of gables contacts are already finished in narrowphase.
change: Under reuse=copy with HOST_S(22) set, narrowphase lists the local indices of contacts that still need persistence (fresh points and reused pairs at rest), eight per record in the unused top of gManifolds (records [candidateCount, maxM) are never manifold slots). gCounters._pad2 (ABI byte 60) counts them. write_work_args_copy_persistent writes slot 70 = listed (or 0 when the list overflowed) and slot 71 = contact count only on overflow. persist_list runs from slot 70 and the full scan from slot 71, so every contact is persisted exactly once in either mode. The indirect buffer grows to 72 slots in both hosts. Browser default persist=list under reuse=copy; native ENGINE_PERSIST=list. HOST_S(23) caps the list for tests.
